meta.title: dsh-better-chat
meta.description: One plugin that ships two agent presets: Chat only (offline) never touches the network; Chat only (online) stays offline unless you explicitly ask it to search. Both accept images, let the model drive its own multi-round thinking (keep_thinking), can search files, and can view pages of .docx/.xlsx/.pptx/.pdf through the Office skill; neither modifies files nor produces deliverables.
